task: positive known axial field; +250 uT known bias; single 100-bin frame

nuisance_holdout.reason: Unseen common resonance shifts, with otherwise matched nuisance priors; no claim about real instruments.

network.checkpoint: fixed final epoch; no selection or architecture search

fit.fallback: Analytic multistart uses its completed six-start search once. Every other method may add one six-start fallback. Any residual rejection returns operational 45 uT.

classical_grid.linear_parameters: contrast,baseline,slope solved by variable projection at grid points

deadline.status: Unknown; not a prerequisite for component profiling or conditional training. No system bandwidth, energy, or instrument usefulness claim.

scope: Component-efficiency software experiment. Population runs and training require root custody certificate and fleet reservations. No FPGA work or hardware access.
prospective_revision: Before any population data: one fixed candidate may train after classical accuracy qualification; no instrument deadline prerequisite.
training_permission: Root-approved exact report with at least one adequate classical baseline; one fixed candidate only. If none qualifies, stop acceleration study.

allocation.meaning: Provisional share of existing fleet caps; no reset or standalone new budget.

classical_single_start_controls.refinement: One identical analytic refinement; same residual-triggered six-start fallback

timing_comparison: Development hybrid timing reuses all saved classical predictions/timings on identical inputs and verified same host/runtime; separate wall runs disclosed. Do not rerun classical development inference.
baseline_selection: Choose fastest adequate among all six on development before training; root freezes exact qualification report and baseline. Confirmation may use one fresh matched all-method run, never retune.
seed_custody: Six distinct 128-bit roots; initial certificate and immutable supplement. Prior integer seeds are below 2^63; two larger old entropies are checked separately. Torch derived seed must match the supplement.
renderer_fit_mismatch: Generator randomizes MW scale and gradient per row. Every fit uses the nominal ten-component mixture, MW1 and gradient0.196875. These unobserved row values are not passed to any estimator; MLP learns under their registered prior.
evidence: Save predictions, truth, flags, timings, source hashes, receipts and paired-bootstrap indices. A NumPy-only independent verifier recomputes every reported metric and gate from saved outputs.
